metadata.description: 60 Group Planning Exercise scenarios for SSB preparation

scenario.title: Flood Relief in Assam Valley
scenario.narrative: You are the leader of a 12-member NCC camp stationed at Guwahati. Sudden flooding from the Brahmaputra has affected 5 villages within a 30km radius. The district administration has requested immediate assistance. You have 8 hours before the waters rise further.

problems.description: Village A: 50 people stranded on rooftops, 3km away
Bridge connecting Village B is damaged
Medical supplies needed at Village C health center
A school bus with 30 children stuck near river crossing
Electric lines down near Village D causing fire risk

scenario.title: Earthquake Response in Uttarakhand
scenario.narrative: You are commanding a 10-member army relief column near Chamoli. A 6.2 magnitude earthquake has struck at dawn. Multiple structures have collapsed in nearby villages. Aftershocks continue. Road to district HQ is blocked by landslide.

problems.description: School building collapsed with students trapped inside
Road blocked by 50m landslide, cutting off 2 villages
Injured villagers need evacuation to hospital 15km away
Dam upstream showing cracks — potential flash flood
Panic among villagers causing stampede risk at relief camp

scenario.title: Cyclone Aftermath in Odisha Coast
scenario.narrative: You are leading a 15-member NDRF-attached unit near Puri. Cyclone Yaas has made landfall. Coastal villages are devastated with storm surge flooding. Communication lines are down. You must coordinate relief before the next tidal wave in 10 hours.

problems.description: Fishing village of 200 people completely submerged, 5km south
Pregnant woman needs emergency medical attention at village clinic
Coastal road washed away, 3 vehicles stranded
Contaminated water supply causing diarrhea outbreak
100 fishermen still at sea, no communication

scenario.title: Forest Fire in Himachal Pradesh
scenario.narrative: You are leading a 10-member forest ranger team near Kullu. A massive forest fire has broken out due to dry summer heat. The fire is spreading towards two hill villages and a wildlife sanctuary. Wind is strong from the west.

problems.description: Fire approaching Manali-bound village of 80 families in 2 hours
Wildlife sanctuary entrance threatened — animals fleeing
3 trekkers trapped on hillside surrounded by fire
Forest department depot with fuel storage at risk of explosion
Creating firebreak needed along eastern ridge

scenario.title: Landslide Rescue in Sikkim
scenario.narrative: You are leading a 12-member BRO team near Gangtok. Heavy monsoon rains have triggered a massive landslide on NH10. A tourist bus and two cars are buried under debris. More rain is expected in 6 hours.

problems.description: Tourist bus with 40 passengers buried under debris — survivors heard
Secondary landslide risk from unstable slope above
Injured driver of car needs immediate medical evacuation
200 vehicles stranded on both sides of blocked highway
Local village water supply pipe damaged by landslide

scenario.title: Border Infiltration in J&K
scenario.narrative: You are the platoon commander of a 10-member patrol team near LoC in Poonch sector. Intelligence reports 5-6 armed infiltrators crossed the border last night. Fresh footprints found near a nala. Local village reports suspicious movement.

problems.description: Fresh tracks leading towards forested area 2km from village
Local shepherd reports armed men hiding in abandoned bunker
Village headman needs to be warned and civilians evacuated
Possible IED planted on approach road to village
Backup reinforcement is 3 hours away by road

scenario.title: Train Derailment near Kanpur
scenario.narrative: You are commanding a 12-member army unit traveling on a parallel route. A Rajdhani Express has derailed near Kanpur. Multiple coaches overturned. Fire has broken out in one coach. Local emergency services are 45 minutes away.

problems.description: Coach S4 on fire with passengers trapped inside
50+ injured passengers scattered along the track
Power lines damaged and sparking near wreckage
Crowd gathering from nearby village causing obstruction
Need to set up triage area and coordinate with approaching ambulances

scenario.title: Chemical Spill near Industrial Area, Vadodara
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member Civil Defence team. A tanker carrying ammonia gas has overturned on the highway near a chemical industrial area. Gas is leaking. Residential colony of 500 families is 1km downwind.

problems.description: Ammonia gas spreading towards residential colony, 200+ at risk
Tanker driver unconscious near leaking tanker
Nearby factory workers showing symptoms of gas exposure
Traffic buildup on highway creating bottleneck for ambulances
School 500m from spill site — 300 children need evacuation

scenario.title: Refugee Camp Setup in Rajasthan
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member humanitarian team. 2000 displaced persons from flood-hit areas have arrived near Jodhpur. A temporary camp must be established within 8 hours. Resources are limited, and tensions are rising among the displaced.

problems.description: Immediate shelter needed for 500 women and children
Clean water supply required — nearest source 3km away
5 severely injured persons need hospital transfer
Two groups fighting over food distribution
Sanitation facilities needed before nightfall

scenario.title: Village Health Camp in MP
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member medical outreach team near Sagar, MP. Your team is organizing a 3-day health camp for tribal villages. Dengue cases have been reported in the area. Local cooperation is mixed — some villages are suspicious of outsiders.

problems.description: Dengue outbreak: 15 confirmed cases in Village Khajuraho
Village elders refusing to let team enter — cultural mistrust
Malnourished children need immediate nutritional support
Road to remote hamlet is unpaved and difficult in monsoon
Blood samples need to reach district lab 50km away by evening

scenario.title: Convoy Protection in Chhattisgarh
scenario.narrative: You are leading a 12-member platoon escorting a supply convoy through Naxal-affected area in Bastar district. Intelligence suggests ambush possibility along a 20km forest stretch. Convoy must reach destination by evening.

problems.description: Suspicious tree felling blocking road at km-8 marker
IED detection alert on alternative route
One vehicle has engine trouble and is slowing convoy
Local informant reports 15 armed Naxals in hills to the east
Nearby village asking for medical supplies during transit

scenario.title: Mountain Rescue in Ladakh
scenario.narrative: You are commanding a 10-member mountain rescue team based at Leh. A group of 8 trekkers is stranded at 16,000ft on the Stok Kangri trail. One has severe altitude sickness. Weather is deteriorating with snowfall expected in 6 hours.

problems.description: Trekker with HAPE (High Altitude Pulmonary Edema) needs immediate descent
Trail partially blocked by fresh avalanche debris
2 trekkers separated from main group, last seen near ridge
Helicopter cannot fly due to cloud cover — ground rescue only
Radio communication intermittent due to terrain

scenario.title: Building Collapse in Delhi
scenario.narrative: You are leading a 15-member rescue team. A 5-storey under-construction building has collapsed in East Delhi. Workers and nearby residents are trapped. Gas pipeline nearby is leaking. Media has gathered in large numbers.

problems.description: Voices heard under debris — estimated 20 workers trapped
Gas pipeline leak creating explosion risk
Adjacent building showing cracks and may collapse
Media and crowd hampering rescue operations
Families of trapped workers becoming agitated

scenario.title: Drought Relief in Maharashtra
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member water relief team in Marathwada region. Severe drought has left 8 villages without water for 3 weeks. Cattle are dying, crops have failed. Government tanker supply is erratic. Tensions between villages over water sharing.

problems.description: Village Parbhani has zero water — 300 people, 200 cattle at risk
Fight between 2 villages over a shared well
3 children hospitalized due to dehydration
Possible groundwater source identified 5km away — needs drilling
Farmers threatening mass protest on state highway

scenario.title: Smuggling Interdiction in Gujarat Border
scenario.narrative: You are commanding an 8-member BSF patrol along the Indo-Pak border in Kutch. Intelligence reports a major narcotics consignment being moved across the border tonight using camel caravans. Your team must intercept without civilian casualties.

problems.description: 3 camel caravans spotted moving towards border fence gap, 4km north
Fence sensor triggered at grid reference 145-327
Local nomad camp near interception zone — civilian safety concern
Supporting team is 2 hours away — you are outnumbered
Fog reducing visibility to 50m in some areas

scenario.title: Education Camp for Tribal Youth in Jharkhand
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member volunteer team setting up a week-long education camp in a remote tribal area near Ranchi. Naxal presence in the area makes security a concern. Most children have never attended school. Parents are skeptical about education.

problems.description: Only 20 children showed up out of expected 100 — parents keeping them away
Local Naxal sympathizer warning villagers not to cooperate
Camp site has no electricity — generator fuel running low
2 children found with untreated injuries
Heavy rain expected — outdoor setup needs weatherproofing

scenario.title: River Expedition Gone Wrong in Rishikesh
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member adventure sports team. During a rafting expedition on the Ganges near Rishikesh, two rafts capsized in rapids. 8 participants are in the water, and equipment is scattered downstream. One person is missing.

problems.description: 1 person missing — last seen going under near Shivpuri rapids
3 people clinging to rocks mid-river in cold water
2 injured with suspected fractures on the far bank
Equipment including emergency supplies washed 2km downstream
Sun setting in 4 hours — need to evacuate before dark

scenario.title: Epidemic Control in Kerala
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member health emergency team in Kozhikode. Nipah virus outbreak has been confirmed. 5 cases identified in 2 days. Contact tracing is ongoing. Panic is spreading among the population.

problems.description: 2 new suspected cases in a crowded market area
Hospital isolation ward is at full capacity
False rumors on social media causing panic buying and migration
Contact tracing reveals 200+ people exposed at a wedding
Local vendors refusing to supply food to affected areas

scenario.title: Road Accident Pile-Up on NH1
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member emergency response team. A fog-related pile-up involving 15+ vehicles including a fuel tanker has occurred on NH1 near Ambala. Visibility is near zero. Fuel is leaking onto the road.

problems.description: Fuel tanker leaking diesel — fire risk with sparking vehicles nearby
Family of 5 trapped in crushed car under truck
More vehicles approaching in fog — secondary accidents likely
20+ injured scattered across 500m stretch
Highway needs to be diverted for both directions

scenario.title: Stranded Tourists in Andaman
scenario.narrative: You lead a 8-member Coast Guard team at Port Blair. A tourist boat with 45 passengers has engine failure near Havelock Island. Sea conditions are worsening. A storm warning has been issued for the next 8 hours.

problems.description: Tourist boat taking on water — 45 passengers including children
3 passengers seasick with severe dehydration
Storm approaching — seas will become rough in 4 hours
Second boat in area also requesting assistance
Communication with Port Blair HQ intermittent

scenario.title: Industrial Riot in Ludhiana
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member rapid response team. Workers of a textile factory have gone on a violent strike after management announced layoffs. They have blocked the highway, set vehicles on fire, and taken the factory manager hostage.

problems.description: Factory manager held hostage in admin building
Highway blocked — 500+ vehicles stranded
Fire spreading to adjacent godown with chemicals
Injured workers need medical attention but refusing ambulance
Political leader arriving may escalate situation

scenario.title: Anti-Terror Operation in Punjab
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member NSG sub-team. Intelligence reports 4 armed terrorists hiding in a farmhouse on the outskirts of Gurdaspur. They have weapons and possibly explosives. Civilian families live in adjacent houses.

problems.description: 4 armed terrorists in fortified farmhouse
3 civilian families in houses within 50m need silent evacuation
Possible IED rigged at farmhouse entrance
One terrorist may have slipped out — tracks heading to railway line
Dawn in 3 hours — lose darkness advantage

scenario.title: Mine Collapse in Jharkhand
scenario.narrative: You lead a 15-member rescue team. A coal mine near Dhanbad has collapsed trapping 25 miners at 300m depth. Methane levels are rising. Rescue shaft is partially blocked.

problems.description: 25 miners trapped — air supply estimated for 8 hours only
Methane buildup reaching dangerous levels near shaft
Rescue shaft blocked by debris at 150m depth
Families of miners gathering — emotional crisis management needed
Second shaft available but needs structural assessment

scenario.title: Desert Survival Exercise in Thar
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member Army training team on a desert navigation exercise near Jaisalmer. A sandstorm has scattered your team. GPS equipment is damaged. Temperature is 48°C. Water supply is limited to 20 liters for the group.

problems.description: 4 team members missing after sandstorm — last bearing: north-east
One member showing signs of heat stroke
Water supply insufficient for full day — dehydration risk
Sand has damaged radio — intermittent signal only
Nearest habitation estimated 15km south-west

scenario.title: Dam Breach Warning in Tamil Nadu
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member disaster management team near Mettur Dam, Salem. Dam engineers report critical water levels and possible breach within 12 hours. 15 downstream villages need evacuation. Monsoon rain continues.

problems.description: Village Cauvery Nagar (5000 people) is in direct flood path
Old bridge is the only exit route for 3 villages — may not hold
Elderly home with 40 residents cannot self-evacuate
Villagers refusing to leave — disbelieving warnings
Livestock need to be moved — farmers insist on saving cattle

scenario.title: Communal Tension in Meerut
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member police rapid action team. A rumor about temple desecration has spread on social media. Two communities are gathering at a junction. Stone pelting has started. Curfew may be needed.

problems.description: 200+ mob gathering at Chowk junction — situation volatile
False social media posts escalating anger — need digital takedown
Shop owners of minority community being targeted
Religious leaders from both sides willing to mediate but need escort
Fire brigade needed — 2 shops set ablaze

scenario.title: Submarine Rescue Exercise
scenario.narrative: You command a 10-member Navy rescue team at Visakhapatnam. A submarine on patrol has reported a hull breach at 150m depth. 40 crew onboard. Rescue submarine is 6 hours away. Surface support must begin immediately.

problems.description: Submarine losing air at 150m depth — 40 crew need rescue
Hull breach in forward compartment — flooding
Communication with submarine intermittent via emergency buoy
Rescue submarine still 6 hours away
3 injured crew need medical attention

scenario.title: Airport Emergency in Bangalore
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member airport emergency team. An aircraft with 180 passengers has reported landing gear failure. Emergency landing imminent on foam-covered runway. Fire and medical teams on standby.

problems.description: Aircraft with 180 passengers attempting belly landing in 20 minutes
Runway needs foam coverage — 2000m strip
Fuel spillage risk post-landing — explosion danger
Other aircraft need diversion — ATC coordination required
Passenger evacuation plan needed for 180 people including infants

scenario.title: Flood Relief Operations in Bihar
scenario.narrative: You lead a 15-member Army relief team in Darbhanga. Kosi river has breached embankment. 20 villages submerged. Thousands displaced. Government relief camps are overwhelmed.

problems.description: 3 villages completely cut off — 2000 people stranded
Embankment breach widening — needs sandbagging
Relief camp running out of food for 5000 displaced
Dead livestock contaminating water — disease risk
Missing persons list growing — 50+ unaccounted for

scenario.title: Peacekeeping Mission Briefing
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member Indian Army contingent deployed with UN peacekeeping force in South Sudan. Local militia has attacked a refugee camp. Ceasefire negotiations are fragile. You must protect civilians while maintaining neutrality.

problems.description: Militia attacking refugee camp — 500 civilians at risk
Ceasefire negotiation team needs escort to neutral zone
Water supply to camp cut off by militia
3 injured peacekeepers need medical evacuation
International media present — actions under global scrutiny

scenario.title: Glacier Lake Outburst in Arunachal
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member SDRF team in Tawang. A glacier lake has burst, sending a wall of water down the Tawang Chu river. Flash flood warning issued for 3 downstream valleys. Communication towers destroyed.

problems.description: Monastery town of 2000 in flood path — 30 minutes warning time
Bridge connecting 2 valleys about to be washed away
Army post with 50 jawans in lower valley
No road access after bridge loss — helicopter only option
Tibetan refugee settlement downstream needs warning

scenario.title: Maritime Piracy off Lakshadweep
scenario.narrative: You command a 10-member Navy team on patrol. A merchant vessel has sent SOS — armed pirates have boarded. 25 crew held hostage. Indian Navy frigate is 4 hours away. You have a fast interceptor boat.

problems.description: 25 hostages on merchant vessel — pirates demanding ransom
Pirates have RPG — direct assault risky
Vessel drifting towards international waters
Frigate 4 hours away — you're the only nearby asset
One crew member reporting via hidden phone — hostages in engine room

scenario.title: Solar Farm Project in Rajasthan Village
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member development team implementing a solar microgrid for 5 villages near Barmer. The project faces opposition from local diesel generator mafia. Installation must be completed before monsoon.

problems.description: Diesel mafia threatening local workers not to assist
Panel mounting structure damaged in transport
Village Sarpanch demanding payment for land use
Monsoon expected in 5 days — need weatherproof completion
2 villages want priority — deciding which gets power first

scenario.title: Avalanche Rescue in Siachen
scenario.narrative: You command a 10-member rescue party at Siachen Glacier. An avalanche has buried a forward post with 12 soldiers at 18,000ft. Temperature is -40°C. Visibility minimal. Rescue window is 6 hours before next storm.

problems.description: 12 soldiers buried under 5m of snow — survival time limited
Secondary avalanche risk from unstable snowpack above
One rescuer developing frostbite symptoms
Communication equipment frozen — intermittent contact with base
Helicopter cannot fly above 15,000ft in current conditions

scenario.title: Hostage Crisis in School, UP
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member STF team. 3 armed men have taken 60 children hostage in a private school in Lucknow. They are demanding release of a jailed criminal. Media is live broadcasting. Parents are frantic outside.

problems.description: 60 children aged 6-12 held hostage in 2 classrooms
Hostage-takers have issued 2-hour ultimatum
One child reported injured — needs medical attention
Parents breaking through police cordon
Live media broadcast compromising tactical positions

scenario.title: Coastal Erosion Emergency in Goa
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member disaster management team. Severe coastal erosion is threatening a fishing village and a heritage church in South Goa. High tide expected in 6 hours. 200 families need relocation.

problems.description: 30 houses dangerously close to eroding cliff edge
Heritage church (300 years old) at risk — ASI wants preservation
Fishermen refusing to leave — boats and nets are their livelihood
High tide in 6 hours will accelerate erosion dramatically
Relocation site has no water or electricity connections

scenario.title: Cross-Border Shelling in Rajouri
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member company at a forward post in Rajouri sector. Unprovoked cross-border shelling has begun. Civilian settlements within 5km are at risk. Ceasefire channel is active but not responding.

problems.description: Shelling hitting near civilian houses — 3 families need evacuation
Forward observation post under direct fire — 2 soldiers injured
Ceasefire hotline not being answered by other side
Ammunition supply route exposed to enemy observation
Brigade HQ requesting situation report and damage assessment

scenario.title: Smart Village Development in Karnataka
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member development team implementing a smart village project near Mysuru. Solar street lights, digital learning center, and water ATM need installation. Budget is tight and monsoon is approaching.

problems.description: Village panchayat wants digital center in their preferred location
Water ATM needs bore well — existing well has contaminated water
Street light locations need survey — some areas have no poles
Electrician didn't show up — need alternative technical support
Women's self-help group requesting skill training center too

scenario.title: Nuclear Plant Emergency Drill
scenario.narrative: You lead a 15-member emergency response team at KAPS nuclear plant, Gujarat. A simulated radiation leak has been declared. Zone A (2km radius) needs immediate evacuation. Iodine tablets must be distributed. Media blackout requested.

problems.description: 5000 residents in Zone A need evacuation within 3 hours
Hospital with 100 patients in Zone B — may need secondary evacuation
Wind direction change pushing plume towards populated area
Panic on social media — need controlled information release
Iodine distribution centers need setup at 3 points

scenario.title: Jungle Warfare Training Gone Wrong
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member training platoon in CIJW school, Vairengte, Mizoram. During a live firing exercise, 2 soldiers are accidentally hit. Dense jungle makes evacuation difficult. Exercise area has unmarked minefields from old operations.

problems.description: 2 soldiers with gunshot wounds — one critical, one stable
Nearest road is 3km through dense jungle
Unmarked minefields from 1990s operations in evacuation path
GPS not working — need manual navigation through jungle
Helicopter landing zone needs clearing in dense canopy

scenario.title: Multi-Agency Terror Attack Response, Mumbai
scenario.narrative: You are the incident commander of a 15-member multi-agency response team. Simultaneous attacks reported at a luxury hotel and a railway station in Mumbai. Multiple casualties. Second wave of attacks possible.

problems.description: 2 terrorists active inside 5-star hotel — 200 guests trapped
Railway station blast — 50+ casualties, shooter possibly still active
Intelligence warns of third target — possible shopping mall
NSG 3 hours away — local police must hold until then
Hospitals overwhelmed — need blood bank coordination
Social media spreading panic — need official communication

scenario.title: Cyber Attack on Military Network
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member cyber defense team at Army Cyber Command. A sophisticated attack has compromised multiple defense networks. Classified data may be exfiltrated. Operations center partially offline.

problems.description: Classified troop movement data potentially compromised
Main operations center offline — need manual workaround
Attack vector traced to spear-phishing — more systems may be infected
Senior leadership needs briefing at 0500 hrs
Backup systems need verification before bringing online

scenario.title: Earthquake + Tsunami in Andaman
scenario.narrative: You command a 15-member NDRF team in Port Blair. 7.5 magnitude earthquake followed by tsunami warning. 30 minutes to tsunami arrival. Multiple islands need evacuation. Infrastructure severely damaged.

problems.description: Tsunami ETA 30 minutes — 5000 coastal residents need warning
Havelock Island resort with 200 tourists — no communication
Earthquake has collapsed hospital wing — patients trapped
Port infrastructure damaged — boats may not launch safely
Naval base needs damage assessment and personnel accounting
After tsunami: search and rescue for missing persons

scenario.title: Insurgency Operation in Manipur
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member Assam Rifles column. Intelligence reports an insurgent arms cache in dense jungle near Myanmar border. Civilian population is mixed — some sympathetic to insurgents. Operations must be surgical.

problems.description: Arms cache location narrowed to 2 possible sites in dense jungle
4 armed insurgents reported guarding one site
Civilian hamlet between both sites — cannot use heavy force
Myanmar border 2km away — insurgents may flee across
Monsoon rain making terrain extremely difficult
Backup from battalion HQ is 5 hours away

scenario.title: Mass Casualty Event at Religious Gathering
scenario.narrative: You lead a 15-member emergency team. A stampede during a religious gathering near Varanasi has caused mass casualties. 50+ injured, 10+ dead. More pilgrims still arriving unaware of the situation.

problems.description: 50+ injured spread across 200m stretch — need triage system
10+ dead — need dignified body management
30,000 more pilgrims approaching from 3 directions
VIP dignitary visit scheduled in 4 hours — security implications
Missing persons helpline needs setup — families searching
Media drones flying overhead — privacy and security concerns

scenario.title: High-Altitude Road Construction, Ladakh
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member BRO detachment building a strategic road at 14,500ft in Eastern Ladakh. Chinese PLA has established observation posts nearby. Construction must continue while maintaining tactical discretion.

problems.description: PLA observation drones spotted — construction visible
Rocky terrain requires blasting — avalanche risk
2 workers developing altitude sickness at 14,500ft
Fuel supply for JCB running low — resupply 2 days away
Section of road needs bridge over 30m gorge

scenario.title: Oil Spill Cleanup in Arabian Sea
scenario.narrative: You command a 15-member Coast Guard environmental response team. An oil tanker has collided with a cargo ship 30km off Mumbai coast. Major oil spill spreading. Marine ecosystem and fishing zones at risk.

problems.description: Oil slick 5km long spreading towards Elephanta Island
Tanker still leaking — hole in hull below waterline
50 fishing boats in contamination zone
Oil reaching mangrove ecosystem near Alibag
Tanker crew of 20 needs evacuation — fire risk

scenario.title: Election Security in Sensitive District
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member CRPF company deployed for election security in a Naxal-sensitive district of Chhattisgarh. Polling booths are in remote areas. Naxals have called for election boycott and threatened violence.

problems.description: 5 polling booths in Naxal-dominated area need security escort
IED found on road to polling station 3
Polling staff refusing to go to remote booth — need motivation
Intelligence: Naxal ambush likely on return route
EVM machines need secure transportation to 3 locations
Tribal village headman mediating — wants security guarantee for voters

scenario.title: Drone Swarm Attack on Air Base
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member air defense team at an IAF base in Punjab. Radar detects 15+ small drones approaching from the west. Some are armed. Base has aircraft on ground. Anti-drone systems are limited.

problems.description: 15+ drones approaching — some carrying explosives
6 aircraft on tarmac need immediate dispersal or sheltering
Fuel depot within drone strike range
Electronic warfare needed — jamming frequencies unknown
Perimeter breach possible under drone cover
Higher HQ needs immediate intelligence assessment

scenario.title: Biological Contamination at Research Lab
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member CBRN response team. A biosafety level-3 lab in Pune reports accidental release of pathogen samples. 30 researchers inside. Contamination zone expanding. Public hospital 500m away.

problems.description: 30 researchers potentially exposed — need immediate quarantine
HVAC system may have spread pathogen to adjacent building
Public hospital 500m away — patients at risk if airborne
Media arriving — need controlled information release
Sample identification needed to determine treatment protocol
Wind carrying potential aerosol towards residential area

scenario.title: Combined Arms Exercise Gone Live
scenario.narrative: You command a 15-member battle group during a combined arms exercise near Pokhran. Exercise scenario unexpectedly aligns with real intelligence of enemy movement near international border 20km away. Exercise may need to transition to real ops.

problems.description: Intelligence confirms real enemy mechanized movement near border
Need to transition from exercise to real defensive posture
Exercise ammunition vs live ammunition inventory mismatch
Civilian villages between our position and border
Communication channels need switching from exercise to operational net
Divisional HQ needs real-time SITREP every 30 minutes

scenario.title: Hostage Rescue Behind Enemy Lines
scenario.narrative: You command a 10-member special forces team. 5 Indian engineers kidnapped by militia in a conflict zone abroad. Intelligence locates them in a compound 30km behind hostile territory. Diplomatic solution failed. Surgical operation approved.

problems.description: 5 hostages in compound guarded by 20+ armed militia
Compound has 3 entry points — guard rotation every 2 hours
Anti-aircraft capability reported in the area
Hostage health unknown — may need immediate medical care
Exfiltration route passes through populated area
Window closes at dawn — loss of darkness advantage

scenario.title: Multi-State Flood Coordination
scenario.narrative: You are the joint operations coordinator managing flood relief across 3 states — UP, Bihar, and West Bengal. Rivers Ganga and Kosi in spate simultaneously. Resources are insufficient. Political pressures from all 3 states.

problems.description: Bihar: 100 villages submerged, 50K displaced, requesting all resources
UP: Varanasi ghats flooding — heritage and religious sites at risk
WB: Sundarbans population cut off — unique ecological zone
All 3 CMs demanding priority allocation — political pressure
Weather forecast: more rain for 72 hours
International aid offered — logistics of acceptance and distribution

scenario.title: Space Debris Emergency Response
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member ISRO emergency team. A defunct satellite is predicted to re-enter atmosphere with debris falling over central India. Impact zone covers 100km radius near Nagpur. Time to impact: 8 hours.

problems.description: Debris field estimated 100km radius — 2 million people in zone
Satellite contains radioactive RTG — contamination risk
Aviation authority needs to close 200km airspace corridor
Hospitals need to prepare for potential radiation injuries
Public panic management — rumors of nuclear bomb
Post-impact debris recovery team deployment

scenario.title: Diplomatic Evacuation from War Zone
scenario.narrative: You command a 12-member military evacuation team. India has ordered evacuation of 500 Indian nationals from a civil war zone in a Middle Eastern country. Commercial flights cancelled. Only military transport available. Embassy under siege.

problems.description: 300 nationals gathered at embassy — compound under mortar threat
200 nationals scattered across city — need collection points
Airport runway damaged — C-17 needs alternative airfield
Route from embassy to port through contested area
15 injured nationals need medical evacuation priority
Local government demanding transit permits

scenario.title: Glacier Expedition Rescue, Karakoram
scenario.narrative: You lead a 10-member Army mountaineering team. An expedition team of 6 climbers is stranded on Saltoro Kangri at 22,000ft. One climber has severe frostbite, another has HACE. Rescue helicopter ceiling is 18,000ft.

problems.description: Climber with HACE deteriorating rapidly at 22,000ft
Descent route has fresh crevasses from recent seismic activity
Weather window closing — blizzard in 6 hours
Helicopter can only reach 18,000ft — 4,000ft gap to bridge
2 rescuers showing early signs of altitude sickness
Pakistani military activity detected near Siachen sector

scenario.title: Urban Warfare Training Complex
scenario.narrative: You command a 15-member infantry company in an urban warfare exercise at MOUT facility. The scenario simulates clearing a town held by insurgents. Live ammunition with safety protocols. Exercise evaluators observing.

problems.description: Building A has 4 'enemy' with hostage — needs room clearing
Sniper position identified in Building C tower
IED simulator on main road — needs route clearance
Civilian role players mixed with enemy — ROE critical
Communications being jammed in sector 3
Evaluators scoring leadership decisions under pressure

scenario.title: Pandemic Vaccine Distribution, Rural India
scenario.narrative: You lead a 12-member health logistics team coordinating COVID-like vaccine distribution across 50 remote villages in NE India. Cold chain maintenance critical. Anti-vax rumors spreading. Monsoon damaging roads.

problems.description: Cold chain break reported in Vehicle 2 — 500 doses at risk
3 villages blocking vaccination teams due to rumors
Road to 10 remote villages washed out — alternate route 40km longer
Health worker shortage — 2 workers fell sick
Generator failure at central storage — backup power needed
Data entry and reporting system needs updating for government portal

scenario.title: Naval Base Defense Exercise
scenario.narrative: You command a 15-member naval base defense team. Intelligence indicates possible underwater saboteur attack on INS Kadamba, Karwar. Fleet assets in port. Exercise must test real preparedness without disrupting operations.

problems.description: Unidentified underwater contact detected near aircraft carrier berth
Perimeter sonar net has gap due to maintenance
Night shift security team is at 60% strength
Civilian fishing boats in restricted zone — need identification
Fleet Commander wants situation report every 30 mins
Submarine scheduled to depart at 0600 — security clearance needed

scenario.title: Joint Special Operations - Island Recapture
scenario.narrative: You command a 15-member tri-service special operations team. A strategic island in the Andaman chain has been captured by hostile forces. 20 civilians held. Diplomatic options exhausted. Joint recapture operation authorized.
